NAI_WA1_EPOCH.title: Birth
NAI_WA1_EPOCH.description:
Since before living memory, the [gold]NaiWa[/gold] have hunted, planted, worshipped, and multiplied here.
They have seen seeds sink beneath the sea, immense trees rise from the earth—and the avatars born of those trees.
NAI_WA1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have completed|Complete} a run as the [blue]Defect[/blue]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA2_EPOCH.title: The Search
NAI_WA2_EPOCH.description:
For hundreds of years, the [gold]NaiWa[/gold] have searched for meaning.
Countless traces left behind tell them: I have been here before.
Perhaps the beings above the [gold]Spire[/gold] know something?
NAI_WA2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have completed|Complete} [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA3_EPOCH.title: Clues
NAI_WA3_EPOCH.description:
The [gold]NaiWa[/gold] try to connect the clues they have found.
As their research deepens, their forms begin to change.
From color to shape—why is this happening?
NAI_WA3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have completed|Complete} [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA4_EPOCH.title: Imprisonment
NAI_WA4_EPOCH.description:
At last, the [gold]NaiWa[/gold] encountered the [blue]Architect[/blue] for a second time.
This time, He was not asleep.
But instead of answering their questions, the [blue]Architect[/blue] [jitter][red]imprisoned[/red][/jitter] every [gold]NaiWa[/gold] in [purple]Naishank Prison[/purple].
NAI_WA4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have completed|Complete} [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA5_EPOCH.title: Suffering
NAI_WA5_EPOCH.description:
The [gold]NaiWa[/gold] cannot escape the place called a prison.
Here, they [red]cannot move[/red]. They see no other creatures—not even one another.
NAI_WA5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have defeated|Defeat} a total of [blue]15[/blue] [purple]Elites[/purple] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA6_EPOCH.title: Laughter
NAI_WA6_EPOCH.description:
The remaining [gold]NaiWa[/gold] learned to [sine][gold]laugh[/gold][/sine].
The most primal emotion halted their [red]transformation[/red].
Led by one [gold]NaiWa[/gold], they used the power of [sine][gold]laughter[/gold][/sine] to send that [gold]NaiWa[/gold] beyond the prison.
The price—that [gold]NaiWa[/gold] [jitter][red]lost their memories[/red][/jitter] once again.
NAI_WA6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have defeated|Defeat} a total of [blue]15[/blue] [red]Bosses[/red] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA7_EPOCH.title: Night Sky
NAI_WA7_EPOCH.description:
[gold]NaiWa[/gold] knew they had to climb this [gold]Spire[/gold] again and again.
But why? For the first time, [gold]NaiWa[/gold] looked up at the [blue]stars[/blue].
NAI_WA7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have completed|Complete} [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]1[/blue] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
NAI_WA8_EPOCH.title: Laugh!
NAI_WA8_EPOCH.description:
[gold]NaiWa[/gold] began to wonder
Which [gold]NaiWa[/gold] first raised their head to see the [blue]stars[/blue]?
When did [blue]starlight[/blue] first fall upon [gold]NaiWa[/gold]?
In [gold]NaiWa[/gold]'s eyes, the [blue]stars[/blue] began to [sine][gold]laugh[/gold][/sine]
[gold]NaiWa[/gold] wondered again
Is this the vast sky's true color?
Or is it simply too distant to see its end?
In [gold]NaiWa[/gold]'s eyes, the [blue]night sky[/blue] began to [sine][gold]laugh[/gold][/sine]
[gold]NaiWa[/gold] looked toward the [gold]Spire[/gold]
Heaven and earth were still so vast
Wind and rain still came and went
[gold]NaiWa[/gold] began to [sine][gold]laugh[/gold][/sine]
NAI_WA8_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:You have completed|Complete} [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]10[/blue] as [gold]NaiWa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
